Version 2.0.0 introduces live trading with Kelly sizing and robust safeguards.

- Adds automated trading: executes trades on zero-fee markets with AI vs market price divergence above 2%.
- Implements Kelly criterion for position sizing, capped at 25% to limit risk.
- Filters only to zero-fee markets to avoid fee drag.
- Introduces safeguards: flip-flop detection, existing position checks, daily budget limits.
- CLI now supports live mode, config inspection/updates, and more granular trade controls.
Filter noise: use /opportunities endpoint to exclude tracking-only markets where divergence is LMSR drift
